title: Stratigas big-band record and playing with Happy Schilling
summary: He describes the commercial Stratigas record and dates his time with Happy Schilling to right after Brownlee's band, around 1926.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: that's funny. Is there any other records that you were on, early records?
Well, after that Ellis Stratigas's Two Sighs, that's strictly a big commercial band. Although it had the sound of a New Orleans band, it sounded sort of like the Owls, you remember?
The sort of big band sound.
I never heard that record even in my life.
No? No, you had a beat-up copy.
Yeah, I have a beat-up copy. I'll let you hear it before you go today. Okay.
When did you play with Happy Schilling?
Oh, I played with Happy Schilling around, right after I left Brownlee. What date could that have been? Around 1926? Something like that.
